scope: Proposed non-blocking UI mapping of the approved skip rule from docs/04-interfeys-i-vzaimodeystvie.md

events.effect: Set blood_test.status=skipped, result=null, completed_count=0; keep doctor order outstanding and show optional reason prompt without a blocking modal
One-tap optional reason; device unavailable sends technical fault note to onboard medic and engineer; other reasons not shared
Only a real verified result can set blood_test.status=completed
Allow later retry with audit trail

privacy.device_unavailable: onboard medic and engineer receive a device problem note
privacy.doctor_report: blood test not performed; skip reason not automatically shared

rules: Skip allowed at any step; no blocking confirmation
Skipped is grey Not measured, never a green check
No automatic diagnosis/zone from missing measurement
No invented lab result; lab turnaround may be longer than active task duration
Emergency remains available in app header
Voice command skip maps to same transition
